mathematical_statement.discretization: the model: cell-centred finite volume with Crank-Nicolson in time, at n_cells and n_steps; samples interpolated linearly between cell centres
equations: rho_c dT/dt = k d2T/dx2 + q, for 0 < x < L and t > 0
dT/dx = 0 at x = 0: the face is insulated (the slab's symmetry plane)
-k dT/dx = h (T - T_inf) at x = L: convection to the surroundings
mathematical_statement.exact_solution: T = T_s(x) + sum_n c_n exp(-k t z_n^2 / (rho_c L^2)) cos(z_n x / L), T_s = T_inf + q L / h + q (L^2 - x^2) / (2 k), z_n tan z_n = h L / k, c_n the projection of T0 - T_s on cos(z_n x / L)
